text:
BIG-IP LTM v11.1.0
Commands Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 11.1.0
CRYPTO::decrypt
- decrypts data.
CRYPTO::encrypt
- encrypts data
CRYPTO::hash
- generates a hash on a piece
of data
CRYPTO::keygen
- used to generate keys
that can be used to encrypt and sign data
CRYPTO::sign
- used to provide a digital
signature of a block of data.
CRYPTO::verify
- used to verify a signed
block of data
DNS::additional
- returns, inserts,
removes, or clears RRs from the additional section.
DNS::answer
- returns, inserts, removes, or
clears all RRs from the answer section.
DNS::authority
- returns, inserts,
removes, or clears RRs from the authority section.
DNS::class
- gets or sets the resource
record class field
DNS::name
- gets or sets the resource record
name field
DNS::origin
- returns the originator of the
DNS message
DNS::ptype
- returns the type of the DNS
packet.
DNS::query
- returns or constructs and sends
a query to the DNS-Express database for a name and type
DNS::rr
- creates a new resource record object
with specified attributes or as a complete string.
DNS::ttl
- gets or sets the resource record
ttl field
DNS::type
- gets or sets the resource record
type field
ifile
- returns content and attributes from
external files on the BIG-IP system
SSL::extensions
- Returns or
manipulates SSL extensions.
Events Introduced in BIG-IP LTM 11.1.0
CLIENTSSL_CLIENTHELLO
- Triggered
when the system has received the client’s SSL ClientHello message
DNS_RESPONSE
- Triggered when the system
responds to a DNS request.
SERVERSSL_CLIENTHELLO_SEND
-
Triggered when the system is about to send its SSL ClientHello
message.
SERVERSSL_SERVERHELLO
- Triggered
when the system has received the server’s SSL ServerHello message.
